label: Ring Video Doorbell Pro 2 (Wired Doorbell Pro)
description: Ring Video Doorbell Pro 2 - now sold as Wired Doorbell Pro - is a hardwired 1536p doorbell camera with 3D motion detection, Bird's Eye View and two-way talk. It is WiFi-only for networking: 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac on 2.4 or 5 GHz; the only wiring it accepts is 16-24 VAC doorbell power, so there is no Ethernet drop and it cannot be cabled into a switch.
